registration: Explicit REGISTRY in launch.py; no automatic directory scanning.

http.readiness: Bound listening socket and unique /health instance id
http.termination: Ctrl+C or optional duration; server socket always closed

cli.completion: One JSON result on stdout; exit zero for confirmed success, nonzero for refusal/failure

resources.sqlite: Per-operation connection, explicit transaction, close in finally; BEGIN IMMEDIATE protects conditional writes
resources.identity: Demo token resolved to trusted context. Internal callers must supply trusted context; not a production security boundary.

aliases.authorized_board: TaskStore instance board_id from composition; cases enforce matching trusted context

limitations: Local Python/SQLite demonstration; no distributed transaction or production authentication guarantee.
Value objects and base classes are optional; minimal needs no value object.
Uncertain write outcome is propagated without automatic retry.
